# Hemanth Tenneti

> Full-stack developer and data analytics practitioner. Builds software products, workflow automations, and business analytics/dashboarding work (Tableau, Python, financial modeling).

Hemanth Tenneti is a full-stack developer and data analytics practitioner based online at https://10eti.me. He builds full-stack products, workflow automations, and data analytics stories that turn messy problems into clear decisions, with a focus on useful interfaces, reliable logic, and AI-integrated tooling.
